rationale: itnet_v2-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=8, batch_size=1, val_chunk=1, grad_clip=1.0, seed=42, pretrain_epochs=56, pretrain_lr=0.001, pretrain_patience=5, itnet_k=1, unet_c=24, residual_learning=False, rationale=iter-7: KNOB=pretrain_epochs 40->56 (single change; KEEP itnet_k=1 and residual_learning=False from iter-6, KEEP pretrain_lr=1e-3, train_n=200, val_n=8). PRIOR RESULT: iter-6 fixed the wiring (itnet_k 3->1) and jumped 0.7459->0.9648, near siblings itnet(v1)=0.9729 / itnet_v3=0.9683. FAILURE MODE: under-trained at the corrected k=1 wiring. The score is climbing monotonically in epochs at k=1 and 0.9648@ep40 sits below the prior itnet_v2 run peak of 0.9714, which the campaign record pins at ep72/k=1. The earlier ep60 COLLAPSE (iter-5, 0.4453) was at k=3 (broken over-constraint regime), NOT a k=1 overfit signal, so the ep40->ep56 climb is well inside the proven ep72/k=1 envelope. HYPOTHESIS: at the corrected k=1 wiring, more epochs (56, toward the prior ep72 optimum) lift 0.9648 toward ~0.971. WALL GUARD: k=1 is cheap (iter-6 ep40/k=1 ran 252s); ep56 ~= 1.4x -> ~350s, well under the 15-min cap; val_n=8 and train_n=200 kept to fit.
